verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents several first-party self-hosting paths: a one-line install script, Docker Compose that generates config and secrets and starts everything, and a single-container Docker option. It is presented as open source and runnable on your own infrastructure. A community user reports running it locally, though they hit a minor unrelated bug and noted missing dev-setup instructions. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of production-grade self-hosted operation, and docs for building or running the self-hosted stack from local source rather than published images.
